_comment: Installed wake words. With the sherpa-onnx engine a wake word is a **keywords file** (BPE-tokenised text), not a trained classifier, so the phrase can be changed here without training anything. 'asset' is a path relative to android/app/src/main/assets/. Entries whose asset is missing are skipped at runtime and reported to Dart through the 'availability' method on the nova/wake_word channel.
